articles.description: Paris Saint-Germain continued to put their early-season struggles behind them by beating Le Mans 3-1 to register a third successive Ligue 1 win.

keyEvents.text: Goal! Rennes 1, Le Mans 0. Estéban Lepaul (Rennes) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Adrien Thomasson.
Goal! Rennes 2, Le Mans 0. Valentin Rongier (Rennes) right footed shot from outside the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Issa Soumaré.
Goal! Rennes 2, Le Mans 1. Louis Mafouta (Le Mans) right footed shot from very close range to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Lucas Calodat with a cross.
First Half ends, Rennes 2, Le Mans 1.
Second Half begins Rennes 2, Le Mans 1.
Issa Soumaré (Rennes) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Rennes 2, Le Mans 2. Louis Mafouta (Le Mans) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the bottom left corner.
Substitution, Rennes. Mahdi Camara replaces Sebastian Szymanski.
Substitution, Rennes. Arnaud Nordin replaces Issa Soumaré.
